comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Quest chain discussed here: Grand Admiral

Steps are easy enough, though.

1. Begin Mercator's charting quest (North Sea mandatory), then chart the Antilles. You don't have to do more than that, technically.
2. From Santo Domingo's Maritime Guild NPC by the bank, pull a quest called "Country of Pirates". Go to Nassau and talk a total of four times (twice for one NPC "Rookie Pirate", twice again with the Marketkeeper), then go to Jamaica and talk to the Port Official twice. Done. (I would guess there's a fame requirement; a friend pulled it with as little as 30k maritime fame.)
3. Now look for "Request from Port Royal", a 17th century phase 4 Chrono quest from Santo Domingo's Maritime NPC. It shows up even with only 9k maritime fame, so it's just a matter of QMPs. Go to Port Royal (you get in free this one time IIRC; costs 1m per visit every other), talk to quest NPCs, sink a target NPC fleet, go back to PR and finish the quest with more talking. No barmaid in town, so you'll have to leave to report at Santo Domingo (or Portobelo's bar guy, if you prefer).

That unlocks the rest of the quest chain. Happy ship sinking, matey. Argh and all that. Cheers!
